---
title: "127gene_cor"
author: "Shan Jiang"
date: "2025-08-26"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Load data
cpd_data <- read_tsv("127genes_CPD_raw_sum.bed", col_names = c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Gene", "X1", "strand", "CPD"))
mutation_data <- read_tsv("127genes_Mutation_counts.bed", col_names = c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Gene", "X1", "Strand", "Mutation"))
merged_data <- inner_join(cpd_data, mutation_data, by = "Gene")

# Replace 0 with 0.1 for log safety
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(CPD = ifelse(CPD == 0, 0.1, CPD),
         Mutation = ifelse(Mutation == 0, 0.1, Mutation))

# Label top and bottom genes
top_genes <- merged_data %>% arrange(desc(Mutation)) %>% head(2)
low_cpd_genes <- merged_data %>% arrange(CPD) %>% head(2)

# Correlation test
cor_test <- cor.test(log10(merged_data$CPD), log10(merged_data$Mutation), method = "pearson")
r_text <- paste0("R = ", signif(cor_test$estimate, 3))
pval_text <- paste0("p-value = ", signif(cor_test$p.value, 3))

ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = CPD, y = Mutation)) +
  geom_point(color = "#7678ed", size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = top_genes, aes(label = Gene), vjust = 0.5, hjust=-0.15, size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = low_cpd_genes, aes(label = Gene), vjust = 0.5, hjust=-0.15, size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = max(merged_data$CPD) * 0.6, 
           y = min(merged_data$Mutation) * 2, 
           label = r_text, hjust = 1.53, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = max(merged_data$CPD) * 0.6, 
           y = min(merged_data$Mutation), 
           label = pval_text, hjust = 0.8, size = 4) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = c("0", "1", "10", "100", "1k", "10k", "50k")
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = c("0", "1", "10", "100", "1k", "10k", "50k")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CPD vs Mutation Log(Count)",
    x = "CPD norm reads",
    y = "Mutation count"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  )


```
